notes.title: v1.8 "The Mug" update
notes.content:
Hi players!
First of all a big thank you for trying our game! We really enjoyed all the videos and reactions, we really enjoyed watching you play our game. We're really grateful for the exposure you provided and we want to say a special thanks to everybody who provided feedback! 

This update changes a few things.
- "The Mug" has been moved, it should now be easier to collect
- changed and hopefully clarified the last level
- added a room
- added/changed scares
- tweaked the rating values to (hopefully) be less punishing
- bugfixes

Here are some videos about the game we really enjoyed:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vqgeDw_z13c&t=232s
